candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory DependencyUnavailable timeouts across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of redis timeouts (load, saturation, network) not established.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests fail with 502 at ~2s. Traces consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timing out, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs to confirm timeout cause (saturation, latency, connection limits).
Inventory service logs/metrics to confirm redis dependency failure propagation.
